# 欽定儀禮義疏

**ID:** KR1d0037
**Custom ID:** ZB1d0032
**Date (file):** 2018-03-31 09:03:06.707254
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V106.1, p1 - V107.1
**Extent:** 48 卷
**Base edition:** WYG

## Authors / Editors
- 高宗弘曆 (清朝) 敕撰 1711 - 1799

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The official Qīng-court commentary on the *Yílǐ* ([KR1d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0025)) in 48 juan, the second part of the *Qīndìng Sānlǐ yìshū* commission of Qiánlóng 13 (1748). Companion to [KR1d0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0018) *Qīndìng Zhōuguān yìshū* and [KR1d0068](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0068) *Qīndìng Lǐjì yìshū*. The 48 juan are organised as: 40 juan covering the seventeen *Yílǐ* chapters; 4 juan of preliminary *gānglǐng* (organising principles) including a *shìgōng* (architectural-spatial) chapter taken from Zhū Xī's edited Lǐ Rúguī text; 4 juan of *lǐqìtú* (ceremonial-vessel diagrams); 4 juan of *lǐjiétú* (ritual-procedure diagrams). The seven-rubric editorial apparatus (*zhèngyì*, *biànzhèng*, *tōnglùn*, *yúlùn*, *cúnyí*, *cúnyì*, *zǒnglùn*) is the same as in the parallel *Zhōuguān yìshū* and *Lǐjì yìshū*. The work draws particularly heavily on Áo Jìgōng's [KR1d0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0035) *Yílǐ jíshuō* — judged by the editors as "the only Yuán-Sòng commentary that subtly corrects the *zhùshū* without polemic" — and supplements with substantial use of Sòng-Míng material.

**Abstract**

The *Qīndìng Yílǐ yìshū* is the Qīng official statement on the *Yílǐ* — the longest of the three *Sānlǐ yìshū* commentaries in the imperial set, reflecting the editors' judgement that the *Yílǐ*'s technical-procedural difficulty had received the least adequate Sòng-Yuán-Míng commentary attention and most deserved a thorough imperial editorial intervention. The work's seven-rubric editorial apparatus (matching the parallel *Zhōuguān yìshū* and *Lǐjì yìshū*) is supplemented by extensive diagrammatic appendices: 4 juan of ceremonial-vessel diagrams (drawing on Niè Chóngyì's [KR1d0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0078) *Sānlǐ tú jízhù*) and 4 juan of ritual-procedure diagrams (drawing on Yáng Fù's [KR1d0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0032) *Yílǐ tú*).

The acknowledged primary source-commentary is Áo Jìgōng's [KR1d0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0035) *Yílǐ jíshuō* — explicitly named by the *fánlì* (editorial conventions) as the work that "opens up Zhèng's note and corrects its errors" without polemical attack. The commission also incorporates the *shìgōng* (architectural-spatial) chapter from Zhū Xī-edited Lǐ Rúguī, the diagrams from Yáng Fù, and supplementary material from Sòng-Míng commentary.

The deputy compilers list (preserved in the prefatory matter and reproduced in detail in [KR1d0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0018)) names many of the same court-classicists who served on the *Zhōuguān yìshū* commission, including Fāng Bāo (compare his [KR1d0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0021) *Zhōuguān jízhù* and [KR1d0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1d/KR1d0041) *Yílǐ xīyí*), Lǐ Qīngzhí, Wāng Yóudūn, and others. Several of the deputy compilers are themselves authors of *Sānlǐ* works admitted to the *Sìkù*.
